label: Friendly
about: Soft rounded forms and pastel light after the DS, 3DS, Wii and Wii U menus, Cocoon and iiSU. Every one carries Friendly's dot pattern.

wallpapers.name: Dot Wave
wallpapers.description: A floating dot grid swelling into a halftone wave toward the edges.

wallpapers.name: Channels
wallpapers.description: Two walls of rounded glossy tiles receding over a floor of dots.

wallpapers.name: Bubbles
wallpapers.description: Soap bubbles with a pastel film drifting up from the corners over the dots.

wallpapers.name: Hills
wallpapers.description: Rolling dotted hills with round trees and soft clouds under a dotted sky.

wallpapers.name: Soft Stripes
wallpapers.description: Diagonal pastel stripes filled with dots, washing out toward the middle.

wallpapers.name: Lagoon
wallpapers.description: Glassy bubbles and soft clouds drifting over a glowing round pool.

wallpapers.name: Confetti
wallpapers.description: Pastel discs, pills and dot patches gathered in the corners around an open middle.

wallpapers.name: Silk
wallpapers.description: Wide satin bands in plum, teal and pearl sweeping across the lower half.

wallpapers.name: Blue Wave
wallpapers.description: Quiet layered swells along the bottom, one of them edged with a thin bright blue line.

wallpapers.name: Soft Horizon
wallpapers.description: A wide soft arc over gentle blue waves, with a few rounded squares floating at the sides.
